# cloud_sdk/instance_manager.rb
require 'async'
require 'async/barrier'
require 'shellwords'

module CloudSDK
  class InstanceManager
    VALID_REGIONS = %w[us-east-1 us-west-2 eu-west-1 ap-southeast-1].freeze
    VALID_ACTIONS = %w[start stop restart status describe].freeze
    MAX_INSTANCE_ID_LENGTH = 19
    INSTANCE_ID_PATTERN = /\Ai-[0-9a-f]{8,17}\z/

    def initialize(config)
      @config = config
      @logger = config[:logger] || Logger.new(STDOUT)
      @cli_path = resolve_cli_path(config[:cli_path] || '/usr/local/bin/cloud-cli')
      @metadata_cache = {}
    end

    def batch_manage(instances, action:, region:, opts: {})
      validate_action!(action)
      validate_region!(region)
      validated_instances = instances.map { |id| validate_instance_id!(id) }

      Async do |task|
        barrier = Async::Barrier.new
        results = Async::Queue.new

        validated_instances.each do |instance_id|
          barrier.async do
            result = execute_action(instance_id, action, region, opts)
            results.enqueue({ id: instance_id, result: result })
          end
        end

        barrier.wait
        collect_results(results, validated_instances.size)
      end
    end

    def describe_with_tags(instance_id, region:, tag_filter: nil)
      validate_region!(region)
      validated_id = validate_instance_id!(instance_id)

      Async do
        metadata = fetch_metadata(validated_id, region)
        if tag_filter
          filtered = apply_tag_filter(metadata, tag_filter)
          enrich_with_dns(filtered, region)
        else
          metadata
        end
      end
    end

    private

    def execute_action(instance_id, action, region, opts)
      cmd = build_command(instance_id, action, region, opts)
      @logger.debug("Executing: #{cmd}")
      stdout, stderr, status = Open3.capture3(cmd)
      unless status.success?
        raise CloudSDK::ExecutionError, "Action #{action} failed: #{stderr}"
      end
      parse_output(stdout, action)
    end

    def build_command(instance_id, action, region, opts)
      base = "#{Shellwords.escape(@cli_path)} ec2 #{action}-instances"
      base += " --instance-ids #{Shellwords.escape(instance_id)}"
      base += " --region #{Shellwords.escape(region)}"
      base += build_opts_string(opts)
      base
    end

    def build_opts_string(opts)
      return '' if opts.nil? || opts.empty?
      opts.map do |key, value|
        sanitized_key = key.to_s.gsub(/[^a-z0-9\-]/, '')
        " --#{sanitized_key} #{transform_opt_value(value)}"
      end.join
    end

    def transform_opt_value(value)
      case value
      when Array
        value.map { |v| Shellwords.escape(v.to_s) }.join(',')
      when Hash
        encode_tag_spec(value)
      when TrueClass, FalseClass
        value.to_s
      else
        Shellwords.escape(value.to_s)
      end
    end

    def encode_tag_spec(tags)
      parts = tags.map { |k, v| "Key=#{Shellwords.escape(k.to_s)},Value=#{Shellwords.escape(v.to_s)}" }
      Shellwords.escape(parts.join(' '))
    end

    def fetch_metadata(instance_id, region)
      cache_key = "#{region}:#{instance_id}"
      return @metadata_cache[cache_key] if @metadata_cache.key?(cache_key)

      cmd = build_command(instance_id, 'describe', region, {})
      stdout, _, status = Open3.capture3(cmd)
      if status.success?
        parsed = parse_output(stdout, 'describe')
        @metadata_cache[cache_key] = parsed
        parsed
      else
        nil
      end
    end

    def enrich_with_dns(metadata, region)
      return metadata unless metadata && metadata[:private_ip]
      dns_name = resolve_internal_dns(metadata[:private_ip], region)
      metadata.merge(internal_dns: dns_name)
    end

    def resolve_internal_dns(ip, region)
      sanitized_ip = ip.to_s.gsub(/[^0-9.]/, '')
      cmd = "#{Shellwords.escape(@cli_path)} ec2 describe-network-interfaces" \
            " --filters Name=addresses.private-ip-address,Values=#{Shellwords.escape(sanitized_ip)}" \
            " --region #{Shellwords.escape(region)}" \
            " --query NetworkInterfaces[0].PrivateDnsName --output text"
      stdout, _, _ = Open3.capture3(cmd)
      stdout.strip
    end

    def apply_tag_filter(metadata, tag_filter)
      return metadata unless metadata.is_a?(Hash)
      filter_expr = normalize_filter(tag_filter)
      metadata.select { |k, _| k.to_s.match?(filter_expr) }
    end

    def normalize_filter(filter)
      if filter.is_a?(Regexp)
        filter
      else
        Regexp.new(Regexp.escape(filter.to_s))
      end
    end

    def validate_action!(action)
      unless VALID_ACTIONS.include?(action.to_s)
        raise ArgumentError, "Invalid action: #{action}"
      end
    end

    def validate_region!(region)
      unless VALID_REGIONS.include?(region.to_s)
        raise ArgumentError, "Invalid region: #{region}"
      end
    end

    def validate_instance_id!(id)
      id_str = id.to_s.strip
      unless id_str.length <= MAX_INSTANCE_ID_LENGTH && id_str.match?(INSTANCE_ID_PATTERN)
        raise ArgumentError, "Invalid instance ID: #{id_str}"
      end
      id_str
    end

    def resolve_cli_path(path)
      expanded = File.expand_path(path)
      unless File.executable?(expanded)
        raise CloudSDK::ConfigError, "CLI not found at #{expanded}"
      end
      expanded
    end

    def parse_output(stdout, action)
      JSON.parse(stdout, symbolize_names: true)
    rescue JSON::ParserError
      { raw_output: stdout, action: action }
    end

    def collect_results(queue, count)
      results = []
      count.times { results << queue.dequeue }
      results
    end
  end
end
